question: Can a separately indexed BO-112 single-cell GEO series supply patient 010/011/012 subtype identities or demonstrate donor overlap for the frozen R6 cell-resolved eligibility gate?
trigger: The worker correctly left GSE313859 patients010/011/012 histology unresolved. Its broad GEO candidate file separately lists GSE279852 with BO112 patient-numbered samples and a three-subtype series description; shared labels are not proof of the same donor.
prespecified_decisive_checks: Compare original GEO series titles, dates, institutions, linked publications and BioSample accession IDs.
Extract all patient-numbered titles and any source-published individual diagnosis fields across both series.
Require a primary source explicit crosswalk or identical BioSample/patient-study identifiers to call donor identity; numerical label alone is insufficient.
If no crosswalk, retain all donor subtype gaps and potential overlap as unresolved.
stop: One bounded official GEO/primary-source metadata check using no more than4MiB retained lead files; no expression values, broad download, blocked-content alternate routes or EMC biology inference.
scientific_meaning: Eligibility/independence challenge only. Even confirmed non-EMC identities would not be a novel EMC biological finding.
